hookText: POV: You caught the inn's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: Whispers of the night still echo through the shadowy inn. My eyes drift from the flickering tallow candles to the distant steps... Could it be him? My new master, Mr. Blackwood, with his piercing gaze and steady hand... I shiver, goosebumps rising as his footsteps draw closer. The scent of cedarwood and lavender soap fills my senses, his breath warm and intoxicating... What will happen when we meet? Will he help me lace my corset or let it fall? I can only imagine... 🕯️✨
caption:
Caught in the moment between candlelight and shadows... What will he choose?
